description: Permanent Database of Known Bugs, Root Causes, and Automated Regression Test Invariants for Eve Virtual Assistant

bugs.title: Chrome Tab Red Blinking Recording Indicator & Background Mic Leak
bugs.symptom: Browser tab constantly displays flashing red microphone recording indicator even when the user is not speaking or has stopped push-to-talk.
bugs.rootCause: isWakeWordActive defaulted to true on cold-start, continuously running SpeechRecognition in passive mode and holding the OS microphone hardware stream open.
bugs.fix: Default isWakeWordActive to false (Push-to-Talk default). Only activate microphone hardware during active push-to-talk interaction or when user explicitly toggles Wake-Word mode.

bugs.title: Ambient Noise Phantom Dialogue Turn Submissions ("See the")
bugs.symptom: Assistant automatically submits turns and answers itself when ambient background whispers or room noise occurs without saying 'Hey Eve'.
bugs.rootCause: wakeWordService contained a fallback regex that classified any 2-3 word ambient phrase as a 'Direct Voice Command', bypassing keyword verification.
bugs.fix: Removed ambient noise fallback. Passive wake-word mode strictly requires an authentic wake-word trigger ('hey eve', 'bonjour eve', 'hallo eve', 'hola eve').

bugs.title: STT Speech-to-Text Language Lock to en-US
bugs.symptom: When user speaks French, German, or Spanish, speech recognition outputs broken English syllables and fails to understand the user.
bugs.rootCause: audioRecorder.ts and wakeWordService.ts hardcoded SpeechRecognition.lang = 'en-US' regardless of user preferred language or browser locale.
bugs.fix: Dynamic locale binding: resolves from localStorage('assistant_preferred_language') or navigator.language (fr-FR, de-DE, es-ES, etc.).

bugs.title: Idle 60fps Canvas Animation CPU Churn
bugs.symptom: Virtual assistant UI causes high CPU usage (~20-30%) and battery drain while sitting completely idle in background browser tab.
bugs.rootCause: MobileVoiceHUD.tsx ran an unthrottled requestAnimationFrame loop continuously calculating sine-waves even when audio level was 0 and assistant was idle.
bugs.fix: Throttled RAF: requestAnimationFrame only schedules loops when isListening || isProcessingSpeech. Renders once statically when idle.

bugs.title: English Fallback Boilerplate Leakage in Non-English Turns
bugs.symptom: When speaking in French or German, unhandled or open-ended queries returned generic English advice ('Regarding this: The clearest path...').
bugs.rootCause: intelligentAdvisor.ts fallback thought generator had hardcoded English template strings.
bugs.fix: Multilingual thought generation with localized responses in French, German, and Spanish with strict zero English leakage.

bugs.title: Emergency Hard STOP Incomplete Hardware Track Release
bugs.symptom: Clicking STOP halted UI visuals but microphone hardware tracks remained alive or audio playback continued in background.
bugs.rootCause: emergencyHaltAssistant did not call MediaStreamTrack.stop() synchronously across all active hardware tracks and did not hard-halt wakeWordService.
bugs.fix: Universal synchronous hardware termination: halts all MediaStreamTracks, stops SpeechSynthesis, calls wakeWordService.hardHalt(), and sets isWakeWordActive=false.

bugs.title: Markdown Formatting & Emojis Spoken Aloud by TTS
bugs.symptom: Assistant voice synthesized punctuation like 'asterisk asterisk' or spelled out URLs and raw emojis.
bugs.rootCause: speechSynthesis.ts did not strip markdown bolding, links, URLs, and unicode emojis before feeding text to SpeechSynthesisUtterance.
bugs.fix: cleanTextForSpeech regex pipeline converts markdown links to plain text, strips asterisks/hashtags/emojis, and normalizes pauses.

bugs.title: Family Nickname & Phonetic Alias Resolution Failure
bugs.symptom: Saying 'Send Eleanor an email' or 'Tell Ellie I am coming' failed to find the contact or created an empty draft.
bugs.rootCause: Memory graph lookup only checked exact string match 'Eleonore Baxter' and did not have phonetic aliases ('Eleanor', 'Ellie', 'Elly').
bugs.fix: Added aliases array to memory graph entities and phonetic normalization in cortexDialogueEngine.

bugs.title: Vacuous Testing & Generic Weather/Calendar Gibberish
bugs.symptom: When asked for weather or calendar details, assistant returned generic boilerplate ('active progress and solid metrics') or hardcoded single appointments, while tests passed due to weak length > 20 assertions.
bugs.rootCause: Tests used vacuous assertions (checking string length > 20) instead of verifying real factual content (temperatures in °C/°F, city names, actual calendar meeting titles and timestamps).
bugs.fix: Built real-time weatherService and calendarService with accurate multilingual briefings, and upgraded test suites with strict factual/semantic assertions banning boilerplate.

bugs.title: Robotic PM Buzzword Boilerplate in General Conversational Dialogue
bugs.symptom: Eve responded to general conversational inquiries with rigid PM jargon ('focus on your primary point of leverage and keep the execution loop lean').
bugs.rootCause: Fallback solver in intelligentAdvisor defaulted to a rigid project management template rather than natural conversational executive dialogue.
bugs.fix: Replaced PM template fallback with natural, intelligent conversational responses across English, French, German, and Spanish, eliminating leverage point / execution loop boilerplate.

bugs.title: Silent Failures & Missing Self-Healing Recovery Loop
bugs.symptom: When cloud model timed out or a service experienced an error, assistant failed silently without informing the user or explaining recovery.
bugs.rootCause: Lack of a centralized resilience service providing natural spoken transparent error recovery and graceful multi-tier degradation.
bugs.fix: Built resilienceService (Self-Healing Feedback & Error Recovery Loop) providing transparent spoken recovery notices across EN, FR, DE, and ES, and automatic local fallback.

bugs.title: Missing Core Voice Assistant Utilities (Time, Math, Timers, Tasks, Reminders)
bugs.symptom: Asking 'What time is it', '15% of 2500', 'Set a timer for 10 minutes', or 'Add task...' returned generic text instead of executing the utility.
bugs.rootCause: cortexDialogueEngine lacked dedicated fast-path voice tool handlers for temporal queries, arithmetic, timers, task creation, and reminders.
bugs.fix: Built real-time time/date engine, percentage/arithmetic math calculator, countdown timer generator, and task/reminder dispatchers into cortexDialogueEngine.
